Name: Comet Collies
Author: CodeNameGeek81
Description:
Ever wanted to have your very own Lassie? This mod replaces the default dogs with rough collies, a sheep herding breed perfectly suited to life on the farm. (Note: this mod does not add herding functionality.)


[b][u]Features:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]4 different coat colours based on real collie colourations.
[*]Includes classic tipped ears as well as alternate prick ears for each coat colour.
[*]Full set of animations and menu icons for each style.
[*]Replace the default dogs in any order (or keep some if desired).
[*]Also supports the Alternative Textures framework.
[/list]
[b][u]Installation:
[/u][/b][list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[*]Install either [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url].
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] ﻿for in-game configuration menu (optional).
[*]Download either the Content Patcher or Alternative Textures version of this mod to match desired framework.
[*]Extract into your \StardewValley\Mods\ folder.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][u]Configuration (Content Patcher version):[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Can be done either through the in-game menu (if using Generic Mod Config Menu) or the config file that is generated when the mod is first run.
[*]The 5 slots correspond to the default dogs in the order they appear in the new game selection (see attached images for chart).
[*]By default, the mod is configured to replace all dogs with a preset mix of styles.
[*]Select "none" to continue using the default dog for that slot.
[/list]
[b][u]Configuration (Alternative Textures version):
[/u][/b][list]
[*]Buy the Scissors item from Robin and use on dog to select desired collie style.
[/list]
[b][u]Styles:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Sable 1 - [i]sable coat with tipped ears[/i]
[*]Sable 2 - [i]sable coat with prick ears[/i]
[*]Sable merle 1 - [i]sable merle coat with tipped ears[/i]
[*]Sable merle 2 - [i]sable merle coat with prick ears[/i]
[*]Tricolour 1 - [i]tricolour coat with tipped ears[/i]
[*]Tricolour 2 - [i]tricolour coat with prick ears[/i]
[*]Blue merle 1 - [i]blue merle coat with tipped ears[/i]
[*]Blue merle 2 - [i]blue merle coat with prick ears[/i]
[/list]
[b][u]Known issues:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Using the Alternative Textures version of this mod, a minor graphical glitch with duplicate heart/sleep bubbles may occur when interacting with dogs. This is purely cosmetic and does not affect functionality of the mod.
[/list]
Please feel free to leave a comment if you have any questions!
~Code_Name_Geek
